messages:
Maya: Small follow-up to the quant profile metadata doc. Two open Qs: 1) how to represent per-layer opt-outs cleanly? 2) what's minimum runtime telemetry to detect fp8 artifacts?

Jin: For per-layer, keep it simple: list of layer patterns or indices. Example: `per_layer_override: [{layer: 34, precision: int8}, {pattern: "attn.*", precision: int8}]`. Keep wildcard allowed.

Omar: Telemetry: suggest add token-level anomaly counter (NaN/nonnumeric outputs), sudden top-k entropy drops, and cross-run KL to baseline. But KL is expensive; only compute on mirrored sample traffic.

Maya: Mirror approach makes sense. Also add `quality_signal_export_v2` to push deltas to the eval service. Keep the runtime hook minimal: push per-request deg_score + context_len + profile_id.

Jin: Can we avoid too much data egress for Private? Provide a local-mode eval runner that writes summaries only. Profile metadata should include `evaluation_mode: {hosted: mirror, private: local}`.

ci-bot: Created draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/812  adds profile schema tests.

Maya: Action items: Jin to add wildcard layer syntax to schema, Omar to list minimal telemetry fields and thresholds, I'll update metadata doc and push a small sample profile JSON.
